text:
anna: Quick design pass on the playground — specifically run history + schema editor + tool-calling UX. Dropping notes here so PMs/engineering can triage.

jorge: great, list the actionable items please.

anna: 1) Run history entries expand the full schema JSON by default. For long schemas this 1) makes page sluggish and 2) breaks keyboard order for screenreaders. Suggest collapsed summary row + explicit expand control (aria-expanded).

kevin: collapsed summary sounds good. Proposal for summary line: `Tool: charge_customer(amount: number)` with a small chevron button to expand.

lina: wording: current button says "View schema" which is vague. Use "Expand schema" / "Collapse schema" and include aria-labels like `Expand schema for charge_customer`.

access-bot: audit: missing aria-controls on chevron, missing role=button for the chevron, expanded region lacks aria-live for async updates.

anna: 2) Function signature needs copy affordance. Many folks want to paste the signature into code samples. Add a subtle copy icon (only visible on hover/focus) with sr-only label `Copy function signature` that copies `charge_customer(amount: number)` to clipboard.

jorge: keep visual noise low. Also add a small toast `Copied signature` that is announced to assistive tech (aria-live=polite).

kevin: 3) Schema editor validation messages are too terse. Example currently: "invalid schema". We have the validation object available (path + message + value). Render as: `At required: expected array of property names (e.g., ["amount"])`. Prefer actionable suggestions and a small "Show example" expander.

lina: for tiny fixes (wrap value in array, coerce string->number) propose an "Auto-fix" button for safe transforms. Always prompt with a confirm and require a changelog reason if saving as canonical schema.

anna: 4) Tool-calling: when model output doesn't match schema we surface a red badge but no quick way to inspect differences. Suggest a compact inline diff showing keys added/removed/typed-changed and a CTA: `Save as new schema version` + `Map field` for manual remap.

access-bot: security note: saving new canonical schema should require a short reason and a checkbox `I verified output safety` for enterprise mode.

jorge: UX idea: two small tabs in the run details: `Output` and `Schema`. Default shows a one-line mismatch summary (e.g., `Output vs schema: 2 mismatches`). Clicking opens a side panel with field-level diffs. Keep diff algorithm key-based not token-based for perf.

kevin: perf note acknowledged. We'll run key-only diffs for 95% of cases, full diffs opt-in.

lina: tiny color/accessibility nit: the red mismatch pill fails AA for small text. Move to darker red or add a 1px high-contrast outline.

anna: also keyboard flow: when you expand an entry, ensure focus lands at the expanded panel's start and that pressing escape collapses it. Document expected focus order in a11y spec.

jorge: can someone mock the collapsed run history item + diff panel by tomorrow? I can show to PMs in the afternoon sync.

kevin: I'll sketch a low-fi and include aria attributes + tab order.

lina: I'll collect translations for common AJV errors into a tiny mapping table that the editor can use to render friendlier messages. Drop them here when ready.

access-bot: infra-bot: created ticket INF-3321 for palette tweak and a11y audit.

anna: thanks all. If no objections I'll convert these notes into a short RFC for the playground UX changes.

jorge: fine by me. thanks :raised_hands:

kevin: looks good.

lina: thanks everyone :sparkles:
